answer: Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the jade is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the inlet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on bonding curves for dynamic participation pricing.
